pi: All values defined here can be inserted anywhere in the params by inserting the
string '!v_pi' where you would like the value of pi to be substituted.
Job variables from workflow will be included here and should therefore be
either accessed here directly or referenced elsewhere in the params by the
same method. Decoding (ie. conversion) can be done by including extra
flags in the substitution directives. eg. '!vni_pi'. Current decoding
options include: n(make negative), i(convert to integer), and
